## Definition of Done (`docs/agents/definition-of-ready-done.md`)

- [ ] D1 Correct: every acceptance criterion demonstrated (list below)
- [ ] D2–D3 Valuable and simple: no speculative scope, no unjustified dependency
- [ ] D4–D5 Design 09 consistency and accessibility checked (visible changes only)
- [ ] D6 Security: backend authorization, validation, no secrets/PII in code or logs
- [ ] D7 Performance considered (queries, pagination, bundle)
- [ ] D8–D9 Tests first; `make lint typecheck test api-check smoke` green; CI green
- [ ] D10 Fresh evidence attached (outputs, screenshots)
- [ ] D11–D12 Independent review done and findings remediated
- [ ] D13 Docs updated where boundaries/contracts changed
- [ ] D14 Stakeholder-ready without explanations
